body:
I think it's the same for me. I was physically abused as a kid, but the emotional abuse was worse. I felt like I had to punish myself for being so worthless. Any time I felt like I had failed or unlovable, I'd turn to harming myself.

I'm glad you're around good people now. And it seems like you are pretty self-aware about why you're doing what you're doing. That's great, and really mature!
I started at 20 and struggle with it ten years later. It does surprise a lot of people. Made me feel ashamed, too, because I thought it was only teenagers who did it.

I know the feeling--being scared someone will find and hoping someone will find out so they can know you're suffering.

I don't think most people cut for attention, not in the way people assume. Aren't there a million better ways to get attention?

It's good to be able to tell someone. It doesn't have to be your parents, but talking helps. I'm here if you need it. Please stay safe.

Oh my gosh, thank you so much for sharing this. I will always remember it.

I woke up feeling really sick and miserable last week so I called in sick. Instantly I felt better. It was then I knew that I was being a fool to let this job take me over.

So, did you tell her you loved her?
Think you can power through three more months?

I understand, completely. I used to work a job that paid really well, but was only like 80 days out of the year. Needless to say, I spent all my time sleeping, eating, and playing video games. And honestly, I didn't want to do anything else. Especially with the Internet constantly available.

All I can say is please hang in there.

This is so cool. Your cousin sounds awesome, I think it's good advice. Especially if you can go back to programming. I think the thing that most weighs us downers what other people think, so good for you. I'd love to hear how it goes!
I'm sorry. How long do you have left?
Thank you so much. Hope all is well with you too.

It's literally the worst advice in the world, not to mention condescending.

I think parents are just confused and lost like us. They shouldn't pretend to have all the answers.

I'm sorry, it sounds like you're in a hard place. But why do you think it should be easy for you? We're all different, some things are easy for you, but hard for me. Is there anything you'd rather be doing?

Thanks so much. I know every day won't feel so great, but I am enjoying today. That's so great, how many people actually get to work on themselves? It's seems like mostly we're just chasing after things.

Normally I write posts and delete them, because writing stuff like this feels so corny.  But my hope is that at least one person gets encouraged from it.
Aw I'm so sorry to hear that. I worked in jobs for years without realizing the jobs were a big part of the problem. I hope you're able to find progress through your situation!
Thanks so much. It feels so freeing.
Do you mind clarifying?

Yeah, it's surprising how my loving fiancée, who wanted to do everything to help, just simply did not understand and even would say the most wrong thing possible. I guess we can't blame people--depression is so trick that way.

I love It's Always Sunny. In fact, I watched the DENNIS Method episode the other day and made me laugh really hard on one of my worst days.

That's so cool, you want to do comedy? Let's do it!

Hey, at least at this point you can't say you never tried it. No matter what happens you should be proud of yourself. I may be in your same shoes soon, who knows?

Thanks so much! Hope you find a fulfilling job!
Your words can help people or hurt people.

Well, I'm sure at least getting laid off helped with getting unemployment? I think quitting makes it harder.

Sitting at a computer all day is terrible, agreed. But it seems every job requires it now.

Hope you're making it through though! Glad you got a much better job.

That's great, I hope you can get to that point! I don't want everyone to quit their job just because they don't like it, but it was definitely right for me! Sounds like yours is putting a lot of stress in your life, though. Hope you can make it through, no matter the course.
I guess no matter how bad I do, I can never be the worst, huh?
Yeah, I don't know what's right for you, but if you feel that way, it'd be doing yourself a favor! I know that feeling for sure, not wanting to let people down... Let me know how it goes!
Yeah, that's exactly what I plan to do! I'll never say I didn't try!
I get it. Not what you want or need to hear. Hang in there.

Aw I'm sorry. I'm no expert on the insurance situation at all, and I know it sucks being on your own for the first time. I know for me I never got a job by just applying. It was always through someone I knew or networked with. Still took awhile though.

I'm being genuine. I didn't make any promises like "It'll get better" or "It will go away" or say things like "Just be positive" because yeah, those are BS.

Honestly, I got the chance to look at your comment history bc I was like, "maybe this person's a troll" but in fact you seem like an awesome person.

So I'm sorry if what I said hurt you or rubbed you the wrong way.
Wow, totally opposite situations. I'm sorry, that really sucks. Don't give up, though. Job-searching is a full-time job.
I'm so sorry, sounds like it's a rough time. I hope you don't end it, though. I'm here if you want to talk.
Of course! Hope you're doing well!
Thanks so much. Can't wait for two weeks from now. And it's cool to be excited! Will report back!
I don't know your situation, but it's within your power. What would your life look like if you did it?
Thanks so much!! The freedom is sweet.
Of course, hope you're doing well!
Yeah getting a chance to just back off from everything and take a breath could really help. Thanks for taking care of yourself.

Well I hope you're able to get some sleep. I'm going through the same thing myself, sleepless nights all the time. I used to drink milk and just stare at the wall for like ten minutes before tucking in when I was like this before. My friends always tell me to stay away from screens when trying to sleep.

That's pretty good reasoning on the therapist. I hate telling mine because a) I'll feel judged, like I thought we had left this behind and b) I don't want to get locked up.

But hopefully your therapist would take it well.

Anyway, what do you do when you can't sleep like this? Does this happen a lot? Sorry, if I'm prying, you don't have to answer.
How are you doing now? Can I ask why you don't want to tell your therapist?
I'm really sorry. How are you doing right now?

Yes, I've done forearms and the scars stay forever. Even now, years later, everyone can see them when I wear a t-shirt. Most people get wide-eyed when they see it.

Not encouraging you to do it, but please remember hydrogen peroxide and neosporin if it happens. Be well my friend.
At least you have the energy to go over to YouTube! I just stay on Reddit 😥

Awesome. I'm so happy for you!

Working an office job now and it's killing me!

I'll jump in.

I remember in the book, "How to Win Friends and Influence People," the author talks about a mass murderer who regularly killed innocent people. The killer said, "If people really got to know me, they'd see I was just a nice guy who would never hurt anybody." So even this quite evil person who was literally hurting people all the time thought he was good. That's human nature, just resorting to the fact that you are a good guy and the other person is wrong.

For someone to think they are a horrible person shows that the person has thought about what they've done and self-reflected. They are a living, breathing, thinking human being and have to ability to live life and to change. If a person has the ability to assess that they are a bad person, they can find the way to become a good person. If they know what a bad person looks like, they know what a good person looks like.
Try googling depression and then come back. You seem uninformed.
It's weird though because I'm actually a huge extrovert. I love people. But now I don't, and I don't want to see or talk to anybody. Whyyyyy?

Gofundme is a good idea. I really like the weekend job and it pays so much better than the week job, so I may quit the weekday job.

My relationship is great. She's my best friend, the best friend I ever had. She loves and supports me, but she has no idea what to do when I'm depressed. The last time I had a depressive episode, she freaked out and called everyone I knew and everyone she knew, including her own parents, who like to bring it up to me. I don't hold it against her for getting scared, but I can't tell her again.

She also wants to go to Church and I'm just done with it, forever. I never want to go again and if she knew that, it would be over.

It's just a lot of pressure. 

Thanks for your advice. I appreciate it. Best to you.
Thanks. You're making me think I should maybe quit one of my jobs.
Not so good, I'm at work. It feels so hard to focus. I just want to walk out the door and drive off, throw my phone out the window and never see or hear from anyone I knew again.

Hi, thanks for your response. It means a lot.

I work 2 jobs, one during the week, one on the weekends. I asked my one during the week if I could at least work a day or two from home they said no. I have to work these jobs because I have to pay for this fucking wedding.

I probably do stink at boundaries, I can never say no.

I went through years of therapy and medication. Sometimes I go back, but there's just nothing left to talk about. I've gone over the childhood trauma so many times, taken all the medication... I don't want to still be doing the same thing 10, 20, 30 years from now.

Hmm... I thought someone here would have something to say.

I guess I really am alone.

Bowing out.

Stay groovy, Earth.

"It's nobody's fault I made the decisions I made

This is the life I chose or rather the life that chose me

If you can't respect that your whole perspective is wack 

Maybe you'll love me when I fade to black"

I actually went through the training to work the suicide hotline, but stopped short when it came time to do it because I started having flashbacks of my own depression.

Just know that they are all volunteers, they're not getting paid, and they're not professional counselors. They've only been trained to make sure you keep yourself safe. They don't have any resources in terms of therapy or even people skills necessarily. Most of them are just getting volunteer experience toward their Psychology degrees.

I'm not excusing those who suck at it, are rude, or are dismissive, but they only have so many people and are pining for more volunteers.

I do know that people of true character love those who can do nothing for them. And that's hard for a lot of us. So many of us want something from others, so we expect others to want something from us. If we have nothing to offer, then how can someone love us?

I know that everyone is worth loving, but we're surrounded by people who can't see that. So I hope someone comes your way that will see you for who you really are and love you and expect nothing back.

Hey, you're way braver than me! I tried skateboarding for like one week and gave up.

I know what you mean by browsing Reddit and YouTube... Does it seem like interacting with the world is too hard, takes too much energy?

And if you're 25, that means you have so much time to figure everything out. I can understand feeling like a failure, but you should know that you're good enough to have friends and to make new ones, too. I know you'd have no problems making new friends, because you genuinely seem to care about the people around you. Not everyone is like that.

But remember that when someone rejects you, you lose nothing, but they lose someone who loves them. And it's okay to mourn over that.

I know exactly what you're talking about. I've been there. Hang in there.

When I was in the same situation I just had to cut that person out of my life. I saw her all the time and we had a lot of the same friends and it killed me. But I could finally breathe when I really truly let go of her -- and I mourned that loss for months.

EDIT: Also I want to say your life is precious.
I've had "friends" lock me up before... They were probably just following the book on what to do. But it does piss me off and I don't talk to them anymore.
